arguments.code: const page = await browser.open('chrome://extensions/'); const state = await page.evaluate(async () => { const items=await new Promise(resolve=>chrome.developerPrivate.getExtensionsInfo({includeDisabled:true,includeTerminated:true},resolve)); return {developerMode:document.querySelector('extensions-manager').inDevMode, extensionIds:items.map(x=>x.id), fluentRead:items.filter(x=>/fluent.?read|流畅阅读/i.test(x.name)).map(x=>({id:x.id,name:x.name,version:x.version,state:x.state}))}; }); return {page:page.id,state,snapshot:await page.snapshot({mode:'interactive',depth:6})};
